content.short: Delio is a secure Web3 open finance platform for digital asset investments.
content.description: Since its founding in 2018, Delio helps users take control of their financial future through secure, intelligent investment solutions tailored for crypto markets. The product lineup spans savings, loans, staking, and STO, empowering thousands of customers to pursue financial independence in a dynamic crypto landscape. Backed by trusted regulatory credentials, including VASP, MSB, and ISMS licenses, Delio serves as a reliable gateway to Web 3.0 open finance.
